items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I believe he played with Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: I used to see Mealy Barnes, the band. I believe he played with Chris Kelly. You did. But I never did notice how much playing he used to do. Mm-hmm. I never did. But they tell me Mealy Barnes was a good clarinet player. Yeah, that's what I heard.
But who was the reading clarinet?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I mean I went down there with Raph and he was supposed to make up, we were supposed to get together but I never did hear from him no more.

ctx.x: Yeah, you just ask Raph about it because, I mean I went down there with Raph and he was supposed to make up, we were supposed to get together but I never did hear from him no more. I can't call his name. Can't call his name to save my life. But he from way downtown there. Was he look like? Used to be a good kind of player with all his teeth out in the front.
Tall, dark fellow. Well that'd be to me, we'll figure out who he is. Mealy Barnes.
